title: chromolaena haughtii
intro: Chromolaena haughtii, commonly known as Hierba de Limon, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena haughtii include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for pain relief, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Chromolaena haughtii include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
